proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Egress for Google Trends requests. The default is Apify Residential proxy in the US; residential traffic is billed per GB from your Apify credits.

anchor.title: Anchor override
anchor.description: Leave empty for automatic: sudoku for 1-hour/4-hour/1-day windows, gpts for 7 days and longer.

geo.title: Default country
geo.description: Default Google Trends country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) when a tool call omits geo.
